tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rong ston chos kyi rje'i rnam par thar pa 'phrin las rgyas shing rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rong ston chos kyi rje'i rnam par thar pa/ 'phrin las rgyas shing rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel bzang po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rgyud pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po rong ston pa shes bya kun rig ces grags shing / mkhan pos gsol gyi mtshan shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'di nyid nges pa'i don du stobs bcu la sogs kyi go 'phang brnyes kyang gdul bya so so'i snang ba dang mthun par sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dam pa rgya gar la sogs grub pa thob pa dang / paṇḍi ta la sogs pa dpag tu med pa'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas rgya gar la sogs par sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed pa dang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ mdo khams kyi phyogs su rigs che zhing ches mtho bar mtho ris kyi yon tan du ma dang / dal 'byor gyi rgyan du mas mdzes par sku 'khrungs shing / tshogs gnyis rlabs po che dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus bod kyi rdo rje gdan chos grwa chen po dpal ldan gsang phu ne'u thog tu phyag phebs te kong ston blo gros dbang phyug la sogs pa rnams la thugs sbyong mdzad pas/ tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos pa tsam gyis/ /gzhung lugs kun shes/ zhes pa dang tshul mtshungs par phar tshad la sogs pa dka' tshegs med par legs par mkhyen nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa'i dus su tshad ma rnam nges kyi ṭīkka mdzad/ blo gsal mang po'i yongs su 'dzin pa chen por gyur te chos bar la phyogs phyogs su byon pa'i tshe yar lung bya sa'i gtsug lag khang du g.yag mi pham chos kyi rje phebs pa gsan pas sngon gyi bag chags bzang ba'i stobs kyis thugs la dga' ba dang spro ba khyad par can skyes te der byon pas yum las 'di dag gang gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas zhes pa'i mdo dang /

sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon byas pa/ /'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ /zhes pa'i chos mtshams su phebs/ rten 'brel legs par 'grig ste mdo bstan bcos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab legs par rgyas/ sde snod 'dzin pa mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor te/ /mtha' yas yul phyogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /lung rigs smra ba'i slob ma khri phrag bzhi/ /yongs su smin par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar sbyin bdag la sogs pa so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ mthun rkyen dang yo byad gang 'dzoms par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing de'i tshe rgyas pa 'bum la sogs pa'i rnam bshad mang du mdzad pa dang / rtsod pa seng ge'i nga ros phas rgol gyi glang po pham par mdzad pa la sogs pa ni/ mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar du gsal zhing / de ltar dgung lo bdun cu la nye ba'i bar du 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba thams cad spangs te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba yis/ /nyin par dge 'dun legs bsdus nas/ /mtshan mo brtson pas grol brnyes pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ gangs can gyi blo gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa phal mo che 'khor du bsdus shing / kha cig ni grub pa'i sa la bzhag la la ni mkhas pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ gzhan dag ni chos sde chen po la sogs pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon du gyur te chos che ba'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par du sngon gyi las dang / smon lam rnam dag gi stobs kyis shel grong pa drung rdor ba khu dbon gyis nye bar mkho ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gzhis ka gong dkar nas sa phyogs dang yul phyogs gang du bzhugs kyang / dpon slob nyi shu'i phogs bza' ma dus rgyun du 'bul ba la sogs pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa la brten nas grub thob chen po gyer sgom zhig pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas snyi phu shug bse ba dang /

mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi pho brang 'u shang do dang / slob dpon chen po padmas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ri bo rtse lnga la sogs pa de rnams 'jig rten la ltos med kyi chos pa rnam dag bzhugs pa'i mthun rkyen tshang zhing 'gal rkyen nyung bar gzigs nas phal cher bzhugs shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de nas stag lo'i ke gsar gyi stobs kyis sa phyogs de rnams 'khrug long mang zhing mi bde bar gyur pa dang / sngon gyi tshogs gnyis rlabs po ches bskrun pa'i mthu dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin nam snyam ste/ dpal gro sa pa'i mkhan po chen po 'od zer rgyal po bas gtso mdzad/ dpon slob thams cad zhal mthun par 'phan yul phyogs la spyan drangs/ gro sa dgon par zla ba gnyis bzhugs/ sde snod 'dzin pa dang / mi chen dang / dad pa can mang du 'dus/ bsnyen bskur dang zhabs tog phun sum tshogs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ de rjes spyan snga rin po che phun tshogs dpal bzang pos dbu mdzad rgyal lha khang ba rnams kyis spyan drangs/ zla ba gcig bzhugs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ zhabs tog phun sum tshogs/ de rjes nyan po dgon par/ rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dpon slob kyis spyan drangs/ zla ba gcig bzhugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ zhabs tog phun sum tshogs/ de nas theg chen chos kyi rgyal po gong la phebs pa'i dus/ chos rje sgo la la 'byon pa'i bsu ba la gro sa tshogs pas byon pa'i tshe/ dgon pa 'dir tshogs pas bzhugs shing gzim khang mdzad pa 'dir gzim ther phub/ chos rjes bzhugs/ zhes chos rje rin po che rgyal rin pa gsung zhing / de dus gzhi bdag gis dgon pa phul zhing rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin nam snyam/ gzhan yang skyid smad ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs dus dgon pa mnal lam du shar ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dug na'ang 'phral gsung tshul dang snang tshul dang bstun na/

mi sde dang lha sde thams cad sbyin bdag dang grwa bu slob tu gyur pa dang / bstan pa'i rgyun la yang phan pa dang / sa phyogs 'di 'dod yon tshang ba sogs gang sa nas legs pa la dgongs nas dgon pa gcig mdzad par bzhed de chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal ba la sogs pa rnams kyis dgon pa gzigs pa la byon pas 'di nyid du rten 'brel 'grig cing / nang so mkhar rtse nas dgon pa dang sa zhing phul zhing / gzim khang gtsang mar brtsigs nas phul ba sogs mdzad/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dgon pa 'debs pa la nged kyis grogs byed gsungs/ mkhar rtser bka' lung snyan bskul yang dag mdzad/ yos lo'i mjug de nyid la gzim khang gi rmang bting / dgon pa btab pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ba dang / chos rjes rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i tshul la sogs pa ni mkhas pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar du gsal/ yos lo'i nang de nyid du gzim khang dang / rgyal rong par rgol ba'i spyi khang gi thad 'dir khang chung gcig rong pa tsha 'phrang pa'i spyi khang gi thad 'dir khang chung gcig dang gsum gyi thog phub/ gzhan rmang mang du things/ de rjes 'phan yul mdar chos rje ba gzhon nu legs grub pas dbu mdzad dpon slob rnams kyis sras khang du spyan drangs te zla ba gcig gi phogs phul/ de rjes de'u gong nas zla ba gcig gi phogs phul/ zla ba gnyis bzhugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i zhabs tog phun sum tshogs/ de rjes phar phyin rang las mkhas pa lo pa tshul dar zhes grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po des lo dgon par spyan drangs te phogs phul/ zla ba gcig bzhugs/ bdag cag phyag phyir yod pa drag zhan thams cad kyis chos rje lo pa la byams chos lnga'i lung zhus/ 'brug lo'i 'go la 'di nyid du phebs te rje rin po ches rin sdings su bzhugs/ mkhar rtse bas gzim khang brtsigs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis mkhar las la 'bad/

'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i 'go la gzim khang ka brgyad ma'i nyis thog legs par grub/ gzhan yang mang du grub/ tshes gsum mchod pa gcig dang bstun nas gzim khang nas mang ja dang tsha ra gzab pa gcig gnang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i sku gcig dang / dpal gur gyi mgon po'i sku gcig dang gnyis nang so nas bzhengs pa la rab gnas mdzad/ de nas chos rje rin po che dang / slob dpon bzod chen pas gtso mdzad dpon slob rnams kyis dgun chos shin tu dmar bar mdzad/ dpyid chos de la shel grong du gdan drangs/ zla gcig bzhugs/ hor zangs spug mo gcig dang / ltar mo dang / phyi sgo dbus 'byed 'di la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba mang du phul/ thugs shin tu mnyes/ kun dga' rwa ba la sogs pa brtsigs pa'i tshul ni/ lo nas phebs pa'i mod de nyid la bla ma thugs rje che ba dang grwa bu slob rgya che ba'i stobs kyis chung na mi shong dgongs nas ka ba brgya nyi shu tsam gyi rmang bting / byang phyogs nyan po bas brtsigs/ nub phyogs gro sa tshogs pas byon nas brtsigs/ shar phyogs khri dpon mtsho skyes pa tshong 'dus na bzhugs dus tshong 'dus pas brtsigs/ lho phyogs zhol char rje bas brtsigs/ gtsang khang bar skor dang bcas pa rgyal mo rong pa dge bshes shes rin zhes bya ba bla ma la dad pa che zhing / spyi sems che ba gcig yod pa des do dam byas bla brang nas zhal bzhugs thog tu legs par grub/ phyis lha mo che bzhengs dus gtsang khang gi thog dpang gtod/ glang thang tshogs pas mdzo mo ra ba yod pa'i thad 'dir tshogs pa nyis brgya shong pa'i khang pa brtsigs nas phul/ lha khang nas gos chen skabs mangs legs pa gcig phul/ gzhan yang sras khang / thang sag lo dgon pa sogs nas ji ltar 'os pa'i yo byad phul te spyi la dgos pa thams cad gzim khang nas thugs khur mdzad pas bla ma'i thugs rjes 'bad med lhun grub tu byung ba yin no/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni/

mkhas pa chen po gzhan dag gis mdzad pa las shes shing / bdag gis cung zad thos pa ni/ skye 'chi la dbang thob par zhal gyis bzhes te bde bar gshegs pa'i lo de bdag chos mgo la bsnyen rdzogs byed par 'dod kyang re zhig 'gyangs pa la dge bshes bsod nams dpal 'phel zhes pa gcig bdag gi rtsar gnang nas bsnyen rdzogs byed na ran nas yod myur bar shog gsungs te bdag gis tshes brgyad la 'dir 'ongs bsnyen rdzogs byas/ bcu bzhi la bde bar gshegs/ chos khri steng du chos gsung ba'i tshe bzhengs nas da ni 'di 'dra yang yang mi yong ngo zhes yang dang yang du gsungs pa dang / chos bar la byon pa rnams la bcu bzhi'i bar sdod/ mang ja mang po 'ong gsungs pa sogs ni rnam thar rgyas par gsal/ gzhan yang deng sang grog po'i nub na myang ral du song ba'i slob dpon legs rgyam pa'i khang pa rnying pa der/ grangs gcig gir tsha bzhes la gdan drangs/ gral der yar lung la sogs par ltas ngan byung ba'i lo rgyus gleng bas ltas ngan gyis lung pa khengs kyang nga ni lo brgyad cu gya lnga sdod/ de nas bltas nas byed gsung / bltas nas byed ces pa de chos rje gzad pa blo rgyam pas gya bdun bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes zhes gsungs pa ltar na dgos pa khyad par can dang gsol ba dang drag tu btab na gya bdun bzhugs pa yin nam snyam/ dam pa rgya gar gyi sprul pa yin pa ni/ ding ri glang 'khor du byon pa'i tshe/ sgrub pa po mtshams la yod pa gcig nyams 'ur nas/ dam pa rgya gar tshes brgyad la 'byon par yod bsu ba la sogs pa'i grabs mi byed pa e yin gsungs/ tshes brgyad la chos rje byon pa yin par 'dug ces pa chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las thos shing drung chen dpal 'byor ba gsung gi 'dug pa yang dran/ chos rje blo rgyam pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa na/ lho brag phyag rdor grub chen rnams kyis ni/ /ma 'ongs sems can kun gyi don slad du/

/dam pa rgya gar sku skyer lung bstan pa/ /zhes pa dang mthun/ yang rong ngur smrig tu/ byang chub sems 'grel gsungs pa'i tshe/ kha che paṇa chen gyis zhabs spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba byung zhes pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel gyi ṭīkka'i mchan la bris 'dug pa bka' 'bum thor bu ba'i zhu dag bdag gis snyan du 'bul ba'i tshe 'di 'dra zhig 'dug zhus pas de 'dra zhig byung gsungs/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus kyi dge slong yin zer ba'i dge slong dbu dkar ba zhig dang rnam pa gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang chen po gcig na gsung rab mang po bzhugs 'dug pa'i 'khrugs pa rnams bsgrigs pa'i snang ba byung gsungs/ mngon shes gsung pa ni mang du yod/ gzhan yang chos rje lha bris bdag la grub rtags shig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ sems can gson po gcig dang ro gcig 'khyer shog gsung / phye ma leb kyi ro gcig dang / byi ba gson po gcig phul bas dmigs pa gcig mdzad pas/ phye ma leb 'phur/ byi ba shi/ yang dmigs pa gcig mdzad pas sngar bzhin du gyur/ yang zhabs pus kyi 'og tu 'jug pa'i khyi'i phru gu gcig yod pa/ thugs 'ur te phyag 'khar bsnun pas re zhig shi/ gsung chos thon pa na longs gsungs pas langs so/ /gzhan yang dus 'khor rgyud 'grel las/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi rus pa ni mu tig tu 'gyur ro zhes pa ltar/ zhabs sen mu tig gi mdog can nya phyis su gyur pa la ring bsrel du ma'i phreng bas mdzes shing / sku gdung rin po cher gyur te mi mang pos kyang theg par dka' ba dang / thog gnyis rim pa dib pa'i tshe dngul gdung la gnod pa gang yang med par gyur pa ni/ rwa sgreng gi rten me thub can rnams dang / ra mo che'i jo bo la mes ma gnod pa dang / srin po ri'i thog dib pa'i tshe bde mchog gi sku la gnod pa med par gyur pa dang tshul mtshungs te shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa yin no/

/yi dam gyi gzhal gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ rnam thar rgyas pa na gsal zhing / mngon pa rang las mkhas pa gzad pa blo rgyam du grags pa des lo gsum gsol ja/ gsol thug skol ba la sogs pa'i phyag phyir bzhugs/ des mdzad pa'i bstod pa las/ yi dam lha yis dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes pas mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dga' ldan gnas su mi pham byams pa yis/ /thugs kyis rjes bzung yang dag don ston pa'i/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan mi g.yo'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lhag pa'i lha dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /dngos su byon nas yang dang yang du gzigs/ /zhes dang / gzhon nu nyid nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /gur gyi mgon dang bstan srung rnams kyis ni/ /rjes su bzung nas yang dag don ston pa'i/ /zhes dang / ri bo rtse lngar bcom ldan sgrol ma dang / /rigs gsum mgon dang ye shes can zung gis/ /dngos su byon nas bstan pa'i sgron mer bstan/ /zhes pa rnams las shes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa dang / skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i ltas ni/ chos rje blo rgyam pa'i mnal lam du/ chos rje rin po che nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'khor mang po la chos ston pa'i rmi lam byung zhus pas de bas lhag par rang gi rmi lam du/ ri rab kyi bang rim gyi steng nas skor ba byas te gling bzhi'i sems can la chos ston pa byung gsung ba dang / rgya nag rgyal pos mchod gnas su spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ dbus gtsang du bzhugs nas bshad snyan mdzad na ji ltar 'gyur dgongs nas mnal lam brtag pa mdzad pas mchod rten chen po gcig gi srog shing las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byas pa byung gsungs/ de rnams ni dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis la rnam nges kyi ṭīkka mdzad pa nas bzung ste dgung lo brgyad cu gya lnga'i bar du 'dul ba me tog 'phreng rgyud kyi ṭīkka tshig don rab gsal gyi gsham na/

bdag gis sde snod gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ /sdom gsum mig 'bras bzhin du gces par bsrungs/ /sgo gsum bya bas thub pa'i bstan pa spel/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes par mdzod/ /ces pa'i tshul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad cing / chos grwa chen po 'di nyid du sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i stobs kyis sang rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyun mi chad par yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel yin no/ /dgon pa btab nas lo brgyad tsam song ba'i khyi lo de la 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung zhing / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi rje rin po che bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba gdan sar bskos te lo bcu bdun bzhugs/ lha mo che dang dngul gdung bzhengs pa sogs bka' drin che/ rje 'di pa gdan sar phebs dus chos rgyal grags pa 'byung gnas pas sngar zhu rten phul ba'i zhal bzhes gcig yod pas dbyar gyi rtsam tshul la pa tshab nas bgos khal nyis brgya dang / gzim khang gong 'og gnyis la lnga bcu lnga bcu re/ lhag gang yod gong ma ngag dbang pas chos rje la chos zhu ba'i yon du phul ba yin/ de nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis byin gyis brlabs pas mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa/ rigs par smra ma rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan pas yos lo la gdan sar phebs/ rta lo la zhi bar gshegs/ de rjes dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa bdag chen rgya gar bas rta lo la gdan sar phebs/ bya lo la gtsang la thegs/ de rjes chos kyi rje kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bya lo'i mjug la 'dir phebs/ bcu bzhi mchod pa'i zla mchod ma chag par 'dzin pa dang / gsung ngag dbyar chos dgun chos la gsung ba sogs thugs rje chen pos khyab par mdzad pas grwa pa thams cad shin tu dad cing 'dun te gdan sar bzhugs par gsol ba btab/

skyes bu chen po 'di ni sku bsod kyi tshogs gzhan las phul du phyin pa zhig ste rgyal bu don grub sku bltams pa na/ bang mdzod 'phel ba dang / gter kha bye ba la sogs pa dge mtshan gyi rtags mang po byung ba dang cha 'dra bar sku bltams pa'i tshe gsol mar zho khru ba gang dkrogs pa na mar khru ba gang du gyur pa la sogs pa mang du byung zhes grags so/ /de nas chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis khyod dgon pa gsum gyi gdan sa byed dgos so zhes lung bstan pa ltar khyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum la gdan sar mnga' gsol te stag lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i bar lo lnga bzhugs/ de'i bar la dang po kun dga' ra ba la wa bad dang / de rjes gtsug lag khang la thigs khang spen bad sogs rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba mdzad/ de rjes yab yum bde bar gshegs pa'i rjes su/ dang por gser dngul ja gos dar sogs legs par btang zhing / de rjes na bza' ber thul lnga yod pa btang / de rjes dngul gyi mchod chas ma gtogs pa phal cher btang zin kyang / dngul gyi mchod chas sogs thams cad bshig dgos pa byung yang / dngul gdung 'di'i zhabs tog gcig mi sgrub pa'i thabs med dgongs te thugs stobs bskyed pas/ sku che ba dang thugs nye ba rnams kyi thugs yul du mi shong ba lta bu byung yang / byung tshad gtong ba'i longs spyod de 'dzad 'dzad 'dra yang mi 'dzad do zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bzo rig pa'i zhabs tog rgyu gser dngul la sogs pa zas nor gyi phung po chen po dgos pa 'dug na'ang / ches lhag pa dang bcas pa grub/ gzhan yang dus chen gyi sgrub mchod zhag lnga gsar du btsugs pa sogs bka' drin shin tu che/ de'i rjes dbur stod sogs kyi sde dgon tshor gsung ngag sogs kyis bstan pa spel/ gdan sa'i khur gzhan la gtang dgos dgongs nas 'os btsal ba na/ chos rje gung ru ba/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang dang / chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la sngags dang mtshan nyid legs par sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis 'os pa yin na'ang /

bcu bzhi mchod pa'i zla ja nang so nas 'dzin dgos pa sogs khur ches pas thugs su ma chud pa la zla ja las tshan kha dgu dang / nang so mkhar rtse ba rnams la 'grems pa sogs mdzad nas chos rje gung ru yos lo zla ba bdun pa la gdan sar bskos te dgun chos kyi lam 'bras dang dus chen gtong ba sogs mdzad nam zla dros nas chos rje gung ru ba gnas gang spror gsung chos gsung ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa mdzad/ chos rje rin po che kun dga' rdo rjes dbyar chos kyi lam 'bras gsungs/ gsung ngag thon pa dang lha khang sogs gang 'os su thugs dam mdzad/ chos rje gung ru ba phebs nas 'bul ba bzhag sgrub mchod dang dus mchod gtong ba sogs thugs mthun zhing / gsung chos 'phel ba byung na'ang / lug lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes gsum la bde bar gshegs/ de rjes byi ba lo bar lo bdun tsam bla brang na gdan sa ba med/ 'on kyang grwa pa gzhan las phul du phyin pa dang / bla ma thugs rje che bas chos kyi srol nyams pa ni med de/ grwa tshang so so'i slob dpon rnams kyis rang rang gi khur 'khur zhing / chos rdzong nas chos kyi rje rin po che blo gros pas gsung ngag la sogs pa gsungs/ slob dpon nam mkha' snying po ba dang / slob dpon 'dul ba bzang po ba la sogs pas gsung ngag la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa'i chos dang / rab 'byams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan pas rgyud gsum kyi bshad pa/ lag len/ sgrig la sogs pa rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dang phyag len bzhin gang la gang 'dod kyis re ba skong bar mdzad/ chos rje gung ru ba bde bar gshegs nas chos rje kun dga' rdo rje ba chos rdzong du bzhugs nas chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi sgo nas gdan sa la bzhugs pa dang khyad med pa mdzad na'ang / sprel lo'i mjug bya lo'i mgo la bde bar gshegs/ bya lo'i dgun chos nas chos rje blo gros pa chos rdzong du phyag phebs te chos rje kun dga' rdo rje bas/

ji ltar mdzad pa ltar mdzad pas grwa pa rnams dad cing 'dun par gyur cing / nang so rin spungs pa dbus phyogs la phebs pa dang stabs 'grig ste/ glang lo la drung don yod pa 'dir phebs nas chos rje blo gros pa gdan sar mnga' gsol te dga' ston la sogs pa phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ chos rje nyid kyang spyir bstan pa'i khur dang bla ma la dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis rje rin po che'i chos khri'i stong nas dbyar chos dgun chos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyun ma chad par gsung ba dang / gsung ngag lam 'bras dang / rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa gdul bya rnams kyi blo'i rim pa dang 'tshams par chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing gzim khang gi mkhar las/ sku 'dra rin po che'i zhabs tog bcu bzhi mchod pa'i dus mchod/ sgrub mchod sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bka' drin che bar yod na'ang / sprel lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu la bde bar gshegs/ bar skabs der bstan pa spyi sgos kyi chag sgo la brten nas gtsug lag khang la zhig ral/ bla ma slob dpon rnams sku gshegs pa sogs ci bya gtol med pa lta bu byung na'ang rje btsun bla ma dam pa de'i thugs rje dang / bka' srung chos skyong gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas gtsug lag khang dang / lha chen gyi zhig gsos la sogs pa legs par grub/ de'i thad du bdag nyid kyis kyang 'khos kha gang yod kyis khur 'khur/ mi sna chos khrims la sogs pa so sos kyang thugs bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas dge bskul 'bul sdud la sogs pa la 'bad pa cher mdzad pas nang so yar mar nas ka gdung gi shing khyad par can 'bul ba sogs kyi sbyin bdag dang / grwa bu slob rnams kyis kyang re ba bzhin thams cad kyis mdzad pas dus chen sgrub mchod sogs dgon pa'i srol ma nyams pa byung ngo / /de rjes yon mchod thams cad bka' bgros te/ bdag chen chos kyi rje spyan 'dren pa'i brtsam pa byas pas gegs dang bar chad gang gi yang dbang du ma shor bar legs par spyan 'drongs te lha mo ches thog drangs rten rnams zhig gsos byas pas sngar las phul du byung ba grub pa dang /

logs bris gsar du grub pa rnams la rab gnas legs par grub/ gsung ngag la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ sde snod 'dzin pa dang mi che dgu mang du 'dus/ bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyis nam mkha' gang ba lta bu byung / de nas rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing / lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i chos kyi rje rin po che mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po la bdag chen chos kyi rjes thugs dam brtag pa lan gsum gyi rab du mdzad pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis kyang lung bstan te phag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gdan sar mnga' gsol lo/ /gdan sar byon pa la grwa pa sbyin bdag 'dun pa dang / bsu ba ser phreng gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo la sogs pa'i bkod pa 'di bas phul du byung ba sngar ma byung zhes grags so/ /mdor na chos grwa chen po 'di'i rmang bting nas bzung ste chos kyi rje rin po mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po gdan sa la phebs pa'i phag lo 'di'i bar la lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun song / de'i bar la gdan sa ba bdun/ rje rin po che nyid dang bla ma'i gtso bo brgyad/ de la chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya lnga bzhugs/ cung zad zhal gyi mthun pa ni/ dgag dgos kyis dgung snying gsang ba yin gyi don la gya lnga yin par skyes bu chen po chos kyi rje gzhon nu seng ge ba dang / chos rje gzhon nu legs grub pa gnyis kyi gsung las 'thad pa dang bcas te legs par thos/ chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal ba ni yos lo pa stag gi lo drug cu tham pa'i steng du bde bar gshegs/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan pa ni yos lo pa rta lo la bdun cu don drug gi steng du bde bar gshegs/ bdag chen rgya gar ba ni da lta yang bzhugs/ chos kyi rje kun dga' rdo rje ba ni 'brug lo pa 'dul ba pa'i lugs kyi bya lo la lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i steng du bde bar gshegs/

chos kyi rje gung ru ba ni yos lo pa lug gi lo la drug cu re lnga'i steng du bde bar gshegs/ chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni byi ba lo pa sprel lo lnga bcu nga bdun gyi steng du bde bar gshegs/ chos kyi rje rin po che mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po ni/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang tshul mtshungs par spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sgos chos grwa chen po 'di'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi slad du brgyad cu gya lnga'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ spyir chos grwa chen po shrī na lend+ra 'di btab pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / yun ring du gnas pa la phan pa sngar yang byung zhing / da dung yang 'byung bar smon lam 'debs/ khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid du yang sngags 'dod pa rnams la sngags/ mtshan nyid 'dod pa rnams la mtshan nyid/ thos bsam 'dod pa rnams la thos bsam/ sgom 'dod pa rnams la sgom/ dbang bskur 'dod pa rnams la dbang bskur/ rjes gnang 'dod pa rnams la rjes gnang / lung 'dod pa rnams la lung la sogs pa thams cad dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos lugs gtso bor gyur cing / gzhan yang rgyud pa rnam par dag pa jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa'i chos skor/ rje btsun mar pa nas brgyud pa dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i chos skor/ khyung po rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa shangs pa'i chos skor/ pha dam pa nas brgyud pa zhi byed kyi chos skor la sogs pa chos 'dod pa rnams la chos 'byung zhing / rgya mtsho chen po la chu phran thams cad ngang gis 'du ba bzhin du sde snod 'dzin pa thams cad dang / phyogs rigs kyi mi chen thams cad dang / dad pa dang ldan pa dang / 'byor pa dang ldan pa dang / blo gros dang ldan pa phyogs mtha' dag nas 'du bas 'jig rten gyi zas nor gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che dang /

ja gos dar rta phyugs la sogs pa thams cad/ dpag bsam gyi shing las 'dod dgu thams cad 'byung ba'am/ gter chen po'i bum pa las 'dod dgu thams cad 'byung ba'am/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las ci 'dod pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ sa skya'i dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis dge bshes legs pa'i blo gros kyis bskul ba dang rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing / grwa pa 'di la thugs zhen che ba rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas sgro bkur med par bris pa'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /dpal ldan bla ma rje btsun thugs rje can/ /deng nas sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar/ /bdag la thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol/ /gang gi thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /chos grwa chen po dpal ldan nā lend+ra'i/ /dam chos pad tshal rgyas par mdzad pa dang / /gang thugs yid bzhin nor bu chen po yis/ /gdul bya'i re 'dod skong bar mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar padmo'i tshal/ /blo gros nyin mo'i zer gyis mdzes byas pas/ /mi zad par du sgrub pa'i brkos byed ni/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal seng ge'i shes bya lags/ /yi ge pa ni blo gsal bzo rig mkhan/ /dpon yig sri bsam zhes bya dad pas bsgrubs/ /par shing 'jam gnyen legs pa'i dpe lo 'di/ /bshes gnyen dge ba'i bshes de'i 'bad pas song / /skyon bral zhus dag sgyu ma'i zlos gar 'di/ /sa skya'i dge slong ye grub bdag gis bgyis/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag ni/ /mkhas grub 'gro ba'i bla ma nam mkha'i mtshan/ /yongs 'dzin gang de'i dri med bkas bskul nas/ /dad ldan rnams kyis gus pa'i blo yis bsgrubs/ /'di bgyis las 'byung rnam mang dge ba'i tshogs/ /rab dkar ston ka'i zla zer lta bu de/

/mtha' yas 'gro ba kun kyang dus kun tu/ /bshes gnyen dam pas 'dzin pa'i rgyur bsngo 'o/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son cing / /zhes sogs chos spyod nang ltar smon lam 'don no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 nam mkha' dpal bzang / rong ston rnam thar phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
